## Experience

- Junior AI Engineer, Cynergy AI & Automation (Feb 2026 – May 2026, India): multilingual real-time ASR pipeline (Faster-Whisper, ElevenLabs STT) for 10+ Indian languages with language detection, speaker diarization, and streaming; "Smart Stitcher" transcript post-processing for rolling-window audio; LLM clinical information extraction with transcript-grounded validation, delivered over FastAPI WebSockets.
- Warehouse Operative, Sainsbury's (Argos) (Oct 2024 – Oct 2025, UK, alongside MSc): worked with Honeywell voice-automation systems.
- ML & Data Intern, Government Tool Training Centre (Jan 2024 – Mar 2024, India): IoT safety-monitoring platform with anomaly detection; ~15% fewer false alerts, ~20% lower response latency.

## Projects

- [Photo-to-Video Pipeline](https://github.com/reh-31/Image-to-Video-Multiagent-Pipeline-): 7-node multi-agent LangGraph pipeline turning photos + a prompt into narrated video; Gemini vision, dual-collection RAG (ChromaDB + sentence-transformers), self-correcting build retries, Remotion rendering.
- [Quantum Caffeinated Chaos](https://github.com/reh-31/quantum-caffeinated-chaos): fully offline RAG QA system (plan → retrieve → answer → reflect) with FLAN-T5 and all-MiniLM-L6-v2; reflection step validates grounding.
- Generative Diffusion Model for Kagome Lattice Design (MSc): fine-tuned Microsoft MatterGen with adapters; 2× discovery rate, ~80% structural validity, ~30% lower compute.
- [AI Music Recommender](https://github.com/reh-31/AI-music-Recommender): TF-IDF + cosine k-NN over the Spotify Million Song Dataset; top-5 results in under a second.
- [PantryPilot](https://github.com/reh-31/PantryPilot): Flask + Gemini app turning ingredient lists into schema-consistent recipes.
- Multi-Class Image Classifier: ResNet50 transfer learning on 25K images; 94.5% validation accuracy; Dockerised REST API.
